title: Ombudsman files charges vs 6 DPWH officials over P491M ‘road rightway’ scam
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Tuesday filed graft and malversation charges before the Sandiganbayan against six former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Tuesday filed graft and malversation charges before the Sandiganbayan against six former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials over their alleged involvement in a P491-million “road right-of-way scam” in General Santos City. In a previous statement, the Ombudsman said it found “prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction” against six officials of DPWH-Soccsksargen, including former Regional Director Subair Saro Diron and former assistant Regional Director Laureano Suan Jr. It added that seven private individuals allegedly involved in the scheme were also charged.
